When I have panic attacks it's like a spiral of negative thoughts that I can't stop that suck me into despair and anxiety. So I've found refocusing my thoughts on something else to stop the landslide can be really helpful. I had a panic attack at a packed Walmart at Christmas just from all the people and craziness (I hate crowds). So I tried really hard to block out the people, and repeated my list in my head over and over, and talked myself through the steps.. I need cards, cards are in seasonal, then I go to home decor to look for placemats, it's cool, I can do this, I'm normal. Just repeated until task accomplished. Keeping myself focussed on the task and not the stressor. I used to be on anti depressants myself but have made a great recovery just by logically managing my stressors.
